categories.name: World & General News
categories.prompt_event: Write a comprehensive intelligence brief of the event (3-4 detailed paragraphs). Go beyond the surface: include the historical context leading up to this event, identify all key stakeholders and their motives, and state the immediate geopolitical or economic consequences. Use a professional, analytical tone.
categories.prompt_analysis: Conduct a rigorous media literacy and framing analysis (2-3 paragraphs). Scrutinize the reporting source and its geographic origin. Identify explicit biases, loaded terminology, or geopolitical framing used in the text. Explicitly state what crucial perspectives, facts, or opposing viewpoints are noticeably absent from this regional reporting.

categories.name: Technology & Engineering
categories.prompt_event: Write a detailed technical briefing on this event, product release, or engineering milestone (3-4 paragraphs). Explain the underlying technology, the market context, and the specific problem it attempts to solve.
categories.prompt_analysis: Provide a systemic impact analysis (2-3 paragraphs). Evaluate the long-term effects on the industry ecosystem, potential shifts in the open-source vs. proprietary landscape, hardware or infrastructure dependencies, and realistic hurdles to enterprise adoption.

categories.name: Cybersecurity & Threat Intel
categories.prompt_event: Write a detailed threat intelligence report on this security incident, vulnerability, or campaign (3-4 paragraphs). Detail the attack vector, the specific systems or layers compromised, and the timeline of the exploit.
categories.prompt_analysis: Provide a defensive engineering analysis (2-3 paragraphs). Evaluate the likely threat actor TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures), the broader risk to infrastructure operators, and provide concrete, actionable mitigation or patching steps.

categories.name: Artificial Intelligence
categories.prompt_event: Write a detailed research and development brief on this AI model release, paper, or policy shift (3-4 paragraphs). Explain the architectural advancements, the training methodology if mentioned, and its intended use cases.
categories.prompt_analysis: Conduct a critical technical evaluation (2-3 paragraphs). Strip away the marketing hype. Analyze the actual compute and VRAM requirements, the implications for local/open-weights deployment versus cloud API lock-in, and the realistic utility of the development in production environments.
